findings.current_behavior: Financial outstanding is fetched only for POSTED SALES_INVOICE. Purchase cards always show grandTotal as Balance even if paid/adjusted. Orders/notes also show grandTotal as if collectible/payable balance.
findings.required_correction: Use authoritative batched financial snapshot for sales/purchase invoices and appropriate nonfinancial balance visibility; preserve signed allocations, credits, advances and reversals.
findings.evidence: Synthetic paid-purchase row grandTotal100/balanceDue0 renders Balance100 and never calls outstanding service. No database writes.

findings.current_behavior: Every SALES_INVOICE is classified from paymentStatus; CANCELLED sale gets no financial snapshot and falls through to SALE:UNPAID.
findings.required_correction: Represent lifecycle first, then payment status only for eligible posted sale; cancelled/reversed history must not suggest new collectible debt.
findings.evidence: Actual server component render of CANCELLED synthetic sale contains SALE:UNPAID and omits CANCELLED.

findings.current_behavior: Dedicated /transactions page does not accept searchParams or expose search/type/status/date/branch filters. Reader applies authorized actor scope only; explicit Home selected branch URL context is not resolved here.
findings.required_correction: Use validated company/selected authorized branch and practical list filters; preserve context into New document and details. Distinguish dedicated Documents list from related mixed Home feed rather than blindly copy all Home modules.
findings.evidence: Source confirmed; no branch authorization bypass asserted; Home related reference reused.

findings.classification: Unbounded list and per-invoice financial queries
findings.current_behavior: listCommercialDocumentsForActor fetches all company/authorized-branch docs with all lines, without pagination; page issues separate outstanding calls per posted sale with Promise.all.
findings.required_correction: Add deterministic server pagination/query projection and batch financial snapshots for visible rows. Filter hidden sale drafts in query; avoid unbounded concurrent transactions. Verify query-count and large-tenant performance.
findings.evidence: Source query shape only; large-tenant load benchmark not executed.

findings.current_behavior: TransactionCardActions More is a detail link rather than reference action menu; Share sends summary text with Invoice title even for purchases and silently falls back to clipboard/errors. Active Home uses different component with PDF sharing already present.
findings.required_correction: Reuse shared permission-aware menu and scoped document file handoff from existing Home/A107/A108 work; keep user confirmation and truthful download/clipboard/cancellation feedback. Do not reimplement already-correct Home PDF sharing.
findings.evidence: Source-confirmed distinct component wiring; physical browser/OS share not executed.
